request.description: Train a fresh PPO policy with the existing full-radius open-branch acquisition recipe augmented by proximity-gated end-effector-speed shaping for low-speed entry and stable hold regulation.
request.rationale: The unresolved distinction is whether the combined branch-consistent and velocity-aware recipe can change the failure mechanism that remained after T2's full-radius open-branch progress shaping. The current implementation already fixes the open branch and samples the full 0.06-0.20 m radius range, but it has no explicit dynamic cost for entering or regulating near the target at high speed.
